# arin_net (Resource)

An existing registry NET adopted by import. Only net_name and comment are
updatable; allocation, reassignment, and removal stay in ARIN Online.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `handle` (String) NET handle, the import identity.

### Optional

- `comment` (List of String) Public comment lines. Per RFC 9092 the geofeed URL
  lives here as a line of the form: Geofeed https://example.com/geofeed.csv
- `net_name` (String) Network name.

### Read-Only

- `net_blocks` (Attributes List) (see
  [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--net_blocks))
- `org_handle` (String)
- `origin_ases` (Set of String)
- `parent_net_handle` (String)
- `registration_date` (String)
- `version` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--net_blocks"></a>

### Nested Schema for `net_blocks`

Read-Only:

- `cidr_length` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `end_address` (String)
- `start_address` (String)
- `type` (String)
